Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all regions with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
3. **Verified recovery**: all regions now on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** `INC-0001` documenting the failure and the rollback; on-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 should not be re-deployed until the root cause is investigated.
